BUYING & PROJECT PLANNING

Glass-Free Event Drinkware: Build a Venue-Approved Brief

Ask the venue which containers it permits before choosing cup shapes, accessories and packing. A plastic material name alone does not establish suitability.

Prepare a Project Enquiry →

Start with the venue’s actual rules

Ask about permitted materials, container size, lids, disposal or return arrangements, and service areas. Do not assume a restriction applies to every venue or every event.

Choose a serving format

Compare a guest cup, flute-shaped vessel or shared pitcher by portion, handling and service workflow. A reference image does not prove impact resistance or hot-drink suitability.

Approve a complete setup

Review the actual cup with its lid, straw, decoration and packing. Agree the intended drink, cleaning and event rules before approving the order.

Before Sending the Enquiry

Review itemWhat to send
Model & portionSKU, vessel shape and required capacity option.
Use & configurationBeverage, temperature conditions, lid, straw or other components.
Artwork & deliveryDesign quantities, decoration position, packing, destination and arrival date.
